column1: # gwt-ledger source registry: one canonical id per source, the slugs that mean the same source, and what it holds.
# country: ISO 3166 code, XX for a source that spans countries. kind: index (transcribed records), image (scans),
# fulltext (searchable text), catalogue (finding aids), newspaper. from/to: the years its records cover, empty when
# open or too varied to say; coverage marks a person n/a when their life falls outside them.
# An id ending in -* covers every id with that prefix. Extend this with your own file: --registry FILE.
